aa_yield.source: Ding et al., Cancers 2022;14:1073, meta-analysis of FIT programmes, pooled PPV for advanced adenoma 27.13% (24.39-29.97), 49 studies. No GCC programme reports an advanced-adenoma count (Qatar, Saudi pilot and the Abu Dhabi audit were checked).
aa_yield.unit: advanced adenomas found per completed colonoscopy after a positive FIT

adv_fraction_ref.source: Corley 2017 abstract: advanced-stage disease (stage III and IV) 8, 7, 7, 9 and 13 per 1,000 in the same five groups; our weighted mean 7.68 per 1,000, so 515 advanced of 1,994 cancers (counts are rate x n, derived).
adv_fraction_ref.unit: share of cancers found within 9 months that are advanced stage (AJCC III or IV)

age_at_diagnosis.source: Abu Dhabi audit (Almansoori, BMC Cancer 2021): mean age 61.1 (SD 11.2) of the 11 cancers, 56.5 of FIT-positives; Corley 2017 median 61. Range 55 to 65 is ours.

colonoscopy_cost_aed.source: Zavis price directory, colonoscopy in Abu Dhabi AED 1,800 to 7,000, indicative figures compiled by the site, not a tariff. The DoH mandatory tariff was not found. The business case leaves this cost out; it is counted here.

crc_risk_ref.source: Corley et al., JAMA 2017;317(16):1631-1641, abstract (PMID 28444278). Pooled groups 8-30 days to 7-9 months: 30, 28, 31, 31 and 43 per 1,000 in 27,176, 24,644, 8,666, 5,251 and 1,335 patients; our weighted mean 29.7 per 1,000. Range: Abu Dhabi audit 11 cancers in 436 colonoscopies (2.5%, Almansoori, BMC Cancer 2021) to Ding 2022 pooled PPV 5.48% (4.96 to 6.02) and Qatar 19 of 375 (5.1%).
crc_risk_ref.unit: probability of any colorectal cancer at colonoscopy within 9 months of a positive FIT

discount_rate.source: 3% a year, the ticket's specification and the common health-economics convention; no UAE guideline was checked.
discount_rate.unit: annual discount rate for life-years and QALYs

fee_per_case_aed.source: business-case.md section 3, option B, an illustrative price, not an offer.

gdp_per_capita_usd.source: World Bank API NY.GDP.PCAP.CD, ARE, 2024 (last updated 2026-10-08). Shown for orientation only; no UAE cost-effectiveness threshold is published.

life_expectancy_uae.source: WHO Global Health Observatory, life tables, indicator LIFE_0000000035 (ex), ARE, both sexes, 2023: e55 29.49, e60 24.79, e65 20.26.
life_expectancy_uae.unit: years of life remaining at age x

or_adv_10_12m.unit: adjusted odds ratio, advanced-stage CRC, 10-12 months vs 8-30 days

or_adv_over_12m.unit: adjusted odds ratio, advanced-stage CRC, more than 12 months vs 8-30 days

or_any_10_12m.source: Corley 2017 abstract: OR 1.48 (95% CI 1.05-2.08), 49 cases per 1,000, n = 748. Kaiser Permanente California 2010-2014, not the UAE; observational.
or_any_10_12m.unit: adjusted odds ratio, any CRC, colonoscopy at 10-12 months vs 8-30 days

or_any_over_12m.source: Corley 2017 abstract: OR 2.25 (1.89-2.68), 76 cases per 1,000, n = 747.
or_any_over_12m.unit: adjusted odds ratio, any CRC, more than 12 months vs 8-30 days

positives_per_year_abu_dhabi.source: business-case.md section 1.1 (derived: 1,264,000 residents aged 40-75 x 20% with a FIT result x 7% positive); range 8,216 to 59,724 is not propagated.
positives_per_year_abu_dhabi.unit: FIT-positive cases a year, Abu Dhabi, central

stage4_share_of_advanced.source: No GCC split for FIT-detected cancers was found. Upper reference: England, all colorectal cancer 2014-2018 with known stage, stage III 30.0% and IV 25.7%, so IV is 46% of III-IV (gov.uk cancer survival in England, 2014-2018). Screen-detected cancers are expected to have a smaller stage IV share; 0.35 (0.20 to 0.50) is our choice.
stage4_share_of_advanced.unit: share of advanced (III-IV) cancers that are stage IV

stage_pair_factor.unit: share of the stage I-IV cost gap that one advanced-to-early shift saves

surv5_distant.source: Saudi National Guard registry distant 20.31% (PMC8390280); SEER distant 16.9% (https://seer.cancer.gov/statfacts/html/colorect.html).

surv5_localized.source: Central: Saudi National Guard registry, 1,012 patients 2009-2017, CRC-specific 5-year survival localized 79.85% (BMC Cancer 2021, PMC8390280), the only GCC stage-specific figure found. High end: US SEER 2016-2022 5-year relative survival localized 91.3%. No UAE stage-specific survival was found.
surv5_localized.unit: 5-year CRC survival, early stage (AJCC I-II, read as SEER 'localized')

surv5_regional.source: Saudi National Guard registry regional 63.25% (PMC8390280); SEER regional 75.2% (https://seer.cancer.gov/statfacts/html/colorect.html).

treatment_gap_aed.source: business-case.md section 4.1: Saudi single-centre study (PMC10630777), USD 45,317 to above 71,374 at 3.6725 = AED 95,694 (central); Malaysian gap AED 17,161 (low).
treatment_gap_aed.unit: AED, first-year treatment cost gap stage I to stage IV

utility_population.source: Janssen et al. 2019, EQ-5D-3L population norms, Table 5: UK-England 0.819 (55-64) and 0.785 (65-74); USA 0.776 and 0.756; Germany 0.881 and 0.838. No UAE or GCC age-specific norms exist (a UAE EQ-5D-5L value set exists, Value in Health 2025, but not norms).
utility_population.unit: EQ-5D utility weight applied to each life-year gained

years_to_death_if_crc_death.source: Our choice; no source. A death avoided gains the remaining life expectancy at diagnosis minus this.
years_to_death_if_crc_death.unit: mean years from diagnosis to death among those who die of CRC within 5 years
